sql: SELECT split_part(ticker,'-',1) AS series, coalesce(settlement_source,'') AS src, left(coalesce(rules_summary,''),700) AS rules, min(title) AS sample_title, count(*) AS n FROM markets WHERE split_part(ticker,'-',1) = ANY(ARRAY['KXNFLSPREAD','KXMLBSPREAD','KXRAIN','KXWTI','KXTRUMPSAY','KXALBUMEQUIV','KXNFLTOTAL','KXITFMATCH','KXMLBHR','KXBTCD','KXWCMENTION','KXINXU','KXWNBASPREAD','KXWTAMATCH','KXNATGASD','KXWCSOA','KXMLBGAME','KXWCGOAL','KXNASDAQ100U','KXETHD']) GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1, 5 DESC
